name: skill-improver
description: Statistically improve an existing Claude skill via a dynamic multi-agent workflow. Fans out four lenses — eval-driven A/B, trigger/description tuning, adversarial weakness hunt, clarity/structure rewrite — each backed by repeated trials and adversarial verification, then gates every proposed change through grill-me before applying. Point it at a SKILL.md and it returns a ranked, evidence-backed change proposal you defend before it lands. Use for improving existing skills; use skill-creator to author new ones.
